items.prompt: Why is a ready phase not enough to resume real traffic?
items.modelAnswer: Evidence flags may be stale/wrong, actual state publication/auth absent; need authoritative business/pending effects/data reconciliation, health/user-flow/restore checks, bounded operational authority and progressive traffic plan. Pure simulation and exceptions do not prove real process/storage/concurrency recovery.
